content.text: 精确定位 section 边界。

input.command:
python3 -c "
import fitz
doc = fitz.open('docs/paper/main.pdf')

# More detailed: find numbered section headers
import re
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    lines = text.strip().split('\n')
    print(f'=== PAGE {i+1} ({len(lines)} lines) ===')
    for j, line in enumerate(lines):
        s = line.strip()
        # Match numbered sections like '1', '1.1', '2', etc. or known keywords
        if re.match(r'^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s+\w', s) and len(s) < 100:
            print(f'  [{j}] {s}')
        elif re.match(r'^(Abstract|Introduction|Related Work|Conclusion|Limitation|Reference|Appendix|Ethics|Acknowledgment)', s) and len(s) < 100:
            print(f'  [{j}] {s}')
        elif re.match(r'^[A-F]\s+\w', s) and len(s) < 100:
            print(f'  [{j}] {s}')
    print()
" 2>&1
